pages.lesson:
LESSON: RESPONSIBILITY PERSONAL AND SCHOOL ITEMS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Values
Topic 4.5: Responsibility Personal and school items

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Responsibility Personal and school items. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LEARN

Today we shall talk about people you can trust at home and at school. We shall talk about people you can trust at home and at school.

Today, we shall talk about the people you can trust at home and at school. Before we start our lesson, what did you learn on protecting ourselves from sexual temptations? # b ell# Learner, have you remembered about protecting ourselves from sexual temptations? # b ell# I hope you mentioned the following: One: We should not give in to sexual temptations T w o: We should be careful when around people of the opposite sex Three: We should not break other people’s trust by doing bad things Four: We can face sexual temptations from different people around us Five: We should always say “NO” to sexual temptations. Six: We should always avoid being in situations that can lead us to sexual sin for example avoiding being alone with people of the opposite sex, unless they are people we trust. # m usic# Today we are going to learn about people we can trust at home and school Whom do you trust at home? Who do you trust at school? # b ell# To trust is the belief that somebody or something is good, It is the belief that somebody sincere or honest and will not try to harm or trick you. It is the belief that somebody sincere or honest and will not try to harm or trick you. Learner we trust our family members, teachers and friends. We trust church leaders and the police too. We are safe with the people we trust. Learner, do you have a bible with you? I will give you time to open Genesis 39: 4-6 and verse 19-20. Genesis 39: 4-6 and verse 19-20. # m usic# Learner, welcome back. Did you open Genesis chapter 39: 4-6 and verse 19-20? Good. Lets now read. Genesis 39: 4-6- verse 19-20 Portiphar was pleased with him and made him his personal servant. So he put Joseph in charge of his house and everything he owned. From then on, because of Joseph the Lord blessed the household of the Egyptian and everything that he had in his house and in his fields. Portiphar turned over everything he had to the care of Joseph and did not concern himself with anything except the food he ate. # m usic#

Now open Genesis 39: 19. Genesis 39: 19 Joseph’s master was angry, when we read Genesis 39: 4-6 and verse 19 we learn that Portiphar saw that the Lord was with Joseph. Potiphar was pleased with him making him in charge of his house and everything he owned. Because of Joseph the Lord blessed Potiphar everything he had in his house and in the fields. Potiphar handed over everything he had to the care of Joseph. Potiphar did not concern himself with anything except the food he ate. Genesis 39: 19 when Joseph’s master Potiphar, heard what his wife had said about what Joseph did when he was away he was furious and he had Joseph arrested and put to prison. # m usic# I hope you have already read Genesis chapter 39 : 4-6 and vesrse 19 to 20. So learner, why was Potiphar pleased with joseph? # b ell# Learner, did you say that it was because Joseph was with the Lord? # b ell# Good, what did the Lord bless? # b ell# Learner, did you say the Lord blessed Potiphar's household and everything he had in his house and in the fields. Very Good What happened to Joseph when Potiphar’s wife lied to his master? # b ell# I hope you said that he was arrested and put to prison. We trust people who are good to us and do not harm us. At home we can trust our parents or guardians and sisters as well as our relatives. At school we trust our teachers and other workers in school. All people that we trust should be well known to us. I hope you have enjoyed the lesson. what have you learned? # m usic# Today we have learned that; One: We should talk to our guardians about people we should trust. T w o: Sometimes the people we trust can harm us. Three: When harmed by anybody we should report to other people that we trust. Four: We should not trust strangers; we should say NO to strangers who give us things or ask to go to somewhere with them. Welcome back, I hope you have enjoyed the lesson. Today we were talking about people I can trust at home and at school. Learner I think of someone you trust at home and at school. Write a poem on a piece of paper on why you trust them. Share the poem with your brothers and sisters at home.

It was recorded by Johnson Mwangi for the Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development. Until next time, Goodbye.

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Responsibility Personal and school items means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Responsibility Personal and school items.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Responsibility Personal and school items
2. Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
3. Learning materials: Grade_4_CRE_Prog_12_People_you_can_trust_at_home_and_at_school
